name: Houfy
description: Back in 2015, our founder, Thijs Aaftink, saw a clear gap in the vacation rental market: commission-heavy platforms that took a cut of every booking, controlled communication, and made things unnecessarily complicated. He knew there had to be a better way. That's how Houfy was born—short for "House For You." It's more than just another vacation rental platform; it's a community-driven alternative to large OTAs, giving hosts full control over their listings while letting guests book direct and save. Since then, Houfy has grown into a trusted marketplace for travelers and hosts worldwide, offering a smarter way to experience short-term rentals. Houfy is the largest vacation rental direct booking advertising platform for rental property types such as homes, condos, cabins, apartments and rooms all over the world. The Houfy community offers more than 87,000 vacation rentals with no service fees. Guests and hosts save money by booking vacation homes directly on Houfy.
